knowledge.title: AI SaaS Development
knowledge.content: GrowthsStack.Dev builds custom AI SaaS platforms for startups, agencies, healthcare, education, finance, real estate, legal firms, and enterprises. SaaS products are designed to be scalable, secure, cloud-ready, subscription-based, and powered by modern AI technologies.

knowledge.title: Technology Stack
knowledge.content: AI SaaS applications are built using Python, FastAPI, Next.js, Docker, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS, REST APIs, OAuth, JWT Authentication, OpenAI API, vector databases, and cloud infrastructure.

knowledge.title: AI Features
knowledge.content: AI SaaS platforms can include AI chatbots, AI agents, document analysis, resume analysis, image generation, AI search, recommendation systems, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, AI reporting, predictive analytics, summarization, translation, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

knowledge.title: Authentication
knowledge.content: Authentication options include email/password, Google, GitHub, Microsoft, Apple, magic links, OAuth, JWT tokens, role-based access control, and multi-factor authentication.

knowledge.title: Subscription & Billing
knowledge.content: Subscription systems support free plans, monthly subscriptions, yearly subscriptions, usage-based pricing, Stripe, PayPal, invoices, coupon codes, trial periods, and recurring payments.

knowledge.title: Dashboard
knowledge.content: Every SaaS platform can include a responsive dashboard with analytics, KPIs, charts, reports, user management, AI insights, notifications, settings, billing, and account management.

knowledge.title: Database
knowledge.content: Supported databases include PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Supabase, Firebase, and vector databases such as Pinecone, ChromaDB, Qdrant, and Weaviate.

knowledge.title: Cloud Deployment
knowledge.content: Applications can be deployed on AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, DigitalOcean, Railway, Render, VPS servers, Docker containers, Kubernetes, and on-premise environments.

knowledge.title: Security
knowledge.content: Security features include HTTPS, encrypted passwords, secure APIs, rate limiting, CORS, RBAC, audit logs, backups, monitoring, environment variables, and secure authentication.

knowledge.title: Scalability
knowledge.content: AI SaaS platforms are designed to scale horizontally and vertically using Docker, Redis caching, background workers, queue systems, load balancing, CDN integration, and cloud infrastructure.

knowledge.title: Integrations
knowledge.content: Integrations include OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Llama, DeepSeek, Twilio, WhatsApp Business API, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Gmail, Outlook, Stripe, PayPal, Google Sheets, Notion, Airtable, HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier, n8n, and custom APIs.

knowledge.title: Industries
knowledge.content: AI SaaS platforms can be built for healthcare, HR, recruitment, education, fintech, legal, e-commerce, logistics, manufacturing, real estate, clinics, restaurants, agencies, and startups.

faqs.question: Can you build an AI SaaS platform?
faqs.answer: Yes. GrowthsStack.Dev develops custom AI SaaS platforms tailored to your business goals, including AI features, authentication, subscriptions, dashboards, APIs, and cloud deployment.

faqs.question: What technologies do you use for SaaS?
faqs.answer: We primarily use Python, FastAPI, Next.js, Docker, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS, OpenAI API, vector databases, and REST APIs.

faqs.question: Can you build a subscription-based platform?
faqs.answer: Yes. We support monthly plans, yearly plans, free trials, coupon codes, usage-based billing, Stripe, and PayPal integrations.

faqs.question: Can AI be integrated into my SaaS?
faqs.answer: Yes. AI chatbots, AI agents, document analysis, search, recommendations, automation, summarization, and RAG can all be integrated.

faqs.question: Do you build multi-user SaaS applications?
faqs.answer: Yes. Multi-user systems with user roles, teams, permissions, organizations, and secure authentication are supported.

faqs.question: Can you build an admin dashboard?
faqs.answer: Yes. Admin dashboards can include analytics, user management, reports, AI insights, billing, settings, and notifications.

faqs.question: Can you integrate Stripe?
faqs.answer: Yes. Stripe subscriptions, one-time payments, invoices, and webhooks are supported.

faqs.question: Can you deploy on AWS?
faqs.answer: Yes. Applications can be deployed on AWS as well as Azure, GCP, Render, Railway, DigitalOcean, and VPS servers.

faqs.question: Can you build healthcare AI SaaS?
faqs.answer: Yes. AI SaaS solutions can be built for healthcare with secure data handling and intelligent automation.

faqs.question: Do you provide post-launch support?
faqs.answer: Yes. Support includes bug fixes, feature enhancements, monitoring, maintenance, and scaling.
